Lipids
Many nutraceuticals have been investigated for their lipid-lowering effects. The International Lipid Expert Panel (ILEP) reviewed
several lipid-lowering nutraceuticals with the objective of providing recommendations for their optimal use to manage dyslipide-
mia in patients not on statin therapy, those on statin or combination therapy who have not achieved lipid goals, and patients with
statin intolerance (Cicero et al., 2017). According to their review, red yeast rice extract, berberine, and omega-3 fatty acids showed
evidence that treatment was beneﬁcial, useful, and effective (Cicero et al., 2017).
Red yeast rice, obtained by the fermentation of yeast (Monascus purpureus) in rice, contains substances with lipid-lowering activ-
ities, including polyketides such as monacolin K, which is structurally identical to lovastatin. Two meta-analyses reported reduction
